mapper.select: SELECT code, label, config_json, update_time FROM telemetry_display_profile ORDER BY code
SELECT code, label, config_json, update_time FROM telemetry_display_profile WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO telemetry_display_profile (code, label, config_json) VALUES (#{code}, #{label}, #{configJson}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE label = VALUES(label), config_json = VALUES(config_json)
